criteria.check: The game reacts to the player's specific action with a visible state or log change rather than repeating the same screen text unchanged.
Across the session, world state visibly advances in at least one of: day counter, docked port, silver, cargo, contract progress, or journal/log entries.
The player is never soft-locked: overlays can close, the chart remains reachable, and Escape or Close is available whenever the UI expects a dismiss.

After Begin only (Fix A hint 1), the first chart makes one starting verb discernible (open Contracts, buy at Market, or sail) from UI, notice, or log. Soft until Fix A chart-hints PR merges — scored every run but not a product-fail until then; then hard. KNOWN GAP — still soft.
Within 30 seconds of New game → Begin, docked identity (port, day, silver, ship) and victory-path names are visible on the chart.
From the docked pier, Contracts opens without hunting through unrelated desks or dead ends.

Immediately after Accept (Fix A hint 2), the next step (load/sail to destination, sell there, then Complete) is obvious from UI, notice, or log — not only from prior knowledge. Soft until Fix A chart-hints PR merges — scored every run but not a product-fail until then; then hard. KNOWN GAP — still soft.
Sailing Porto Novo to Al-Manar (lane Sail or chart arm) with Next day shows depart, voyage progress, and Docked at Al-Manar.
At the contract destination, selling the contract good then opening Contracts shows Complete (or sell already settles the contract); Complete is idempotent when shown.

When an encounter overlay opens, it feels like an intentional interrupt with clear stance choices; signed delta appears on resolve. Preferred product path on tip cc2c50e4: Hunt target on seed 1 (forage + bounty → Hunt → encounter). Seed 1 Grain Road may skip combat (not a fail); Fix B alt remains seed 4 --encounter-screen / encounter_seed4.
After Spare or Take all, the #41 victory receipt lines (silver, loot or untouched, standing, companion flavor) read as a reward beat, not a raw log dump.
After at least one voyage beat, Journal opens and the Victory section is readable with requirements vs status, not an empty dead end. Covers Fix A hint 3 (victory → Journal).

Escape / ui_cancel closes each member overlay the same as Close (confirm-first): Contracts, Shipyard, Harbour, Journal, Crew, Hunt, Day's report; in encounter, Escape only leaves when Leave/Back is visible. Membership per playtest-escape-undock-criteria.md. Known-fail until docked-consistency PR merges. KNOWN GAP — do not flip live.

After a notable Next day, Day's report shows only content among: up to 3 deadlines with "days left" (never "due soon"); captain health (captain only); prices for the docked port only; claimable bounty once and again on arrival days. Closes in one action (Close or Escape); other docked desk opening closes it. Never traps the loop: after dismiss, Sail and Next day are immediately usable (covering chart while open is by design). Quiet day = no auto panel; health notable only for Healed and 1-day heal milestone. Fail if remote-port prices, crew health lines, "due soon", or >3 deadlines.
